description.value: Fullfill Zero Waste Market is Kimberley's dedicated zero-waste and bulk-goods shop, stocking package-free pantry staples, spices, supplements, and a range of reusable everyday items including water bottles and coffee cups. The store also carries solid shampoo, conditioner, and body bars — useful for cycle tourers looking to lighten their load with compact, plastic-free personal care. It is one of the few businesses of its kind in the East Kootenay region and offers both in-store and online shopping.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at fullfillmarket.com is live and provides clear contact details, store description, and product categories. The website consistently spells the name 'Fullfill Zero Waste Market' (no hyphen), while OSM records 'Full-Fill Zero Waste Market' — a discrepancy flagged in concerns. No mentions of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific infrastructure appear anywhere in the website content; the OSM tags are sparse and add nothing on these points. The business sells bulk pantry staples (spices, baking goods, supplements) confirming basic grocery relevance, though the OSM tag 'greengrocer' understates what is actually a zero-waste lifestyle and bulk-goods store.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Full-Fill Zero Waste Market' (hyphenated) but the business's own website consistently uses 'Fullfill Zero Waste Market' (no hyphen).
OSM tag shop=greengrocer does not accurately reflect this business, which is a zero-waste lifestyle and bulk-goods store rather than a produce shop.
OSM record contains no address or phone; both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed for phone and address cannot be verified against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible zero-waste bulk goods store in Kimberley with a functioning website and verified contact details. Useful resupply stop for touring cyclists seeking pantry staples or reusable gear.
